think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and intended meaning. 2) Check official Postgres documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change the knob’s behavior qualitatively (disable/auto/switch mode) rather than just scaling it. 3) Determine whether such values are valid and documented, and whether they break the natural numeric ordering by triggering a different mode. 4) If no sentinel values exist and the knob is purely a cost multiplier across its numeric range, classify it as not special.
